items.title: Fred Lipsius interviewed by Monk Rowe. Boston, Massachusetts, July 25, 2018
items.q: when I watched Johnny Carson years ago, as a comparison, he’s great, everybody loves him, loved him.

ctx.x: You are extremely easy. When I was watching Phil Woods to, the interview, I told my wife, I said, “He is great.” Like when I watched Johnny Carson years ago, as a comparison, he’s great, everybody loves him, loved him. But sometimes, maybe because he was a little nervous or on cocaine or something, he would interrupt people. And you don’t really do that. And sometimes if you don’t interrupt someone, and you give them something to say and you give them the right little seed you know, they might have a memory of…
